h1: Saudia Additional Baggage Options and Fees | Saudia
html:
Additional Baggage

Additional baggage allowances without extra cost

AlFursan Member

  • Domestic Flights

    Saudia provides additional baggage allowances to its guests without extra cost as per the following table:

    AlFursan Member: Domestic Flights
    AlFursan Member Baggage
    AlFursan GOLD MEMBER One piece up to 23 kg
    AlFursan SILVER MEMBER One piece up to 23 kg
    ELITE One piece up to 23 kg
    ELITE PLUS One piece up to 23 kg

  • International Flights

    Saudia provides additional baggage allowances to its guests without extra cost as per the following table:

    AlFursan Member: International Flights
    Sector (From/To) First Class Business Class Guest Class
    Elite/ Elite Plus(AlFursan Silver/Gold) One piece up to 32 kg One piece up to 32 kg One piece up to 23 kg

    * All 6th freedom passengers from/to USA and Canada are allowed to carry 2 pieces for all classes.

    Note: checked baggage on Saudia flights departing to USA stations (New York (JFK), Washington D.C. (IAD), Los Angeles (LAX)) and Canada (Toronto (YYZ)) from (Riyadh (RUH)) must be sealed using safe wrap prior to acceptance on the flight.

Exceptions

Extra baggage isn’t granted in the following cases: 

- Code Share  - SPA Agreement & NEGO  - Promotional Fares  - Combining with other airlines.

** Notes:

  • The patient to ensure that all of the solutions are packed in bags or special containers preventing liquid leakage and being put in easy held containers so that customer service agents at the airport can receive the baggage & acceptit.
  • The free baggage allowance is according to the number of pieces shown in the ticket that shall not exceed 23 Kg.
  • The free baggage allowance is according to the number of pieces shown in the ticket that shall not exceed 32 Kg.
  • (8) additional free pieces shall be waived, not exceeding 32 Kg noting that the number of free pieces will not appear in the passenger’s ticket.
  • When the patient is at the airport, the free additional baggage will be accepted based on the special card issued from the Saudi Center for Organs Transplantation.
  • When baggage exceeds the allowable number of pieces, size, or weights, the passenger shall be directed to the sales offices at the airport to collect fees.

Excess Baggage Charges for Sport Equipment

  • International flights

    1. Add (100$) USD fees on pieces exceeding the approved dimensions from 158 cm (62 inch) to be 205 cm (80 inch).
    2. Extra charge are added (67$) USD for objects exceeding the approved dimensions from 205cm (80 inch) to a maximum extent 300cm (118 inch), where the amount will be as follows: (100+67=167$ USD).
    3. When the dimensions are exceeding 300cm (118 inch), or having extra weight more than 32 Kg (70 Ibs), then it is accepted via Cargo.
    4. Additional fees from/to Canada must be charged amounting to (89) Canadian Dollar, per piece exceeding the approved dimensions, where the total amount will be calculated as follows (100+89= 189 Canadian Dollar).

  • Domestic flights

    1. Add 100 SAR fees for each piece exceeding the approved dimensions from 158 cm (62 inch), and less than 205 cm (80 inch).
    2. Add extra charges 100 SAR for each piece exceeding the approved dimensions from 205 cm (80 inch), with maximum 300 cm (118 inch) where it will be charged as follows: (100+100=200 SAR).
    3. When dimensions exceed 300cm (118 inch) or having extra weight more than 32kg (70 lb.), then It is accepted through Cargo only.
